scripts.dictation:smoke: powershell.exe -NoLogo -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ./scripts/capture-codex-dictation.ps1 -Prompt "Dictation smoke test. Say a short answer, then press Alt+N." -TimeoutSeconds 120
scripts.schema:generate: codex app-server generate-ts --out ./schemas/typescript && codex app-server generate-json-schema --out ./schemas/json
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests plugin/job-form-voice-bridge/mcp package.json tsconfig*.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests plugin/job-form-voice-bridge/mcp package.json tsconfig*.json
scripts.verify: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run format:check && pnpm test
